walkthroughs.body_html:
Decision Making to Improve Financial Performance — a core area of A-Level Business Studies.

Working through it builds the schema you need: the key terms, how they connect, and how to use them together.

Decision Making to Improve Financial Performance brings together several ideas you need to use as a set, not in isolation.

Lock in the vocabulary first, then practise pulling the ideas together to answer real questions.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Decision Making to Improve Financial Performance.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.

mcqs.q: Modigliani and Miller's irrelevance theorem was published in:

options: Annual cost calculation
Cost of capital
Capital ceiling
Credit cycle
Shareholders' personal assets are protected if the company fails — they can only lose the amount they invested, not their personal wealth.
Limited liability means a business can only operate for a limited time.
Hygiene factors are about workplace cleanliness.
Limited liability means the company has limited debts it can take on.
